query: Who was the US president when the Berlin Wall fell?
answer: George H. W. Bush, the 41st president, was in office when the Berlin Wall fell on November 9, 1989. He had become president in January of that year [1][2]. In public he kept a calm, restrained tone because he didn't want to provoke Soviet hardliners. Behind the scenes he did a lot of personal diplomacy with leaders such as Helmut Kohl and Margaret Thatcher [2]. He stayed in close contact with Kohl until Germany reunified on October 3, 1990 [3].
